newsitem.title: USA: Carnival Air secures $25 mln revolving credit.
newsitem.headline: Carnival Air secures $25 mln revolving credit.

text.p: Carnival Air Lines said Friday it has executed a commitment letter with NationsBank Corp which will establish two credit bridge facilities for up to an aggregate of $25 million.
The two $12.5 million facilities are to be guaranteed by Pan Am Corp, which expects to complete its acquisition of Carnival this summer, the company said.
The credit vehicles would be the first arranged for use by the new combined airline when the closing is consummated, it said. The Pan Am shareholder vote is tentatively targeted for late August.
Each facility will mature one year after the date of the closing, Carnival said.

Amounts borrowed under the facility guaranteed by Micky Arison, Carnival's principal shareholder, will bear interest at the prime rate while any amounts drawn on the facility guaranteed by Pan Am will bear interest beginning at 3 percent annually above prime for the first six months, and increasing by 1.5 percent annually for each of the following three-month periods.
